title: Judgment Isn’t Issued: How Officers Learn to Make the Call

Judgment Isn’t Issued: How Officers Learn to Make the Call
Marine Pulse
Amy McGrath and Gary Sampson
November 19, 2026

Episode Notes:
Retired Marine Lieutenant Colonel Amy McGrath joins Gary Sampson to discuss how officers learn to exercise judgment. She recalls drawing on years of training when her F/A-18 crew unexpectedly took the lead on a mission in Iraq. At the Naval Academy, she taught midshipmen why understanding American government and politics matters when they lead Marines and sailors overseas. McGrath also describes working with civilian agencies at Headquarters Marine Corps and serving as a Congressional Fellow in Rep. Susan Davis’s office. She closes with a practical suggestion for leaders and teachers: Give junior officers evidence to work through and room to reach their own conclusions.
